content: Sneha Roy called insurance agent Anjali Desai to inquire about reactivating her recently cancelled auto policy (AG-2026-015). Since the policy is fully expired, Anjali explained that a new quote would be generated. They discussed a six-month term policy for Sneha's 2022 Honda Civic with a premium of roughly ₹6,300. Anjali sent a secure payment link via email, informing Sneha that a new policy number (AG-2026-078) would be assigned. Sneha agreed to proceed with the payment.

action_items: Agent sent secure payment link and quote PDF via email
Customer to complete payment via net banking
Agent to issue new policy certificate (AG-2026-078) once payment is processed
